instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: The way researchers looked at the data matters. They separated differences between people from changes within one person. One example is, that person works harder than I do and earns more. Another question is, how did my personality change after my income changed? They moved from ranking people by yearly income to following one person over time. It was a different contest altogether. The trait they focused on was conscientiousness, the habit of working seriously and steadily. Their study found that, within the same person, higher income was linked to greater conscientiousness later on. Wait, we thought personality affected income, but income had a part too. But the arrow does not point only one way. A rise in conscientiousness was also weakly linked to higher income later. They found a weak link in both directions, personality with later income and income with later personality.
